parsed.main_gap: The crux of the lower bound (Lemma 4) — the tree-component/signed-sum inequality |Ξ| ≤ Σε_i + [M odd]a_M — is asserted with "standard; details omitted", so the lower bound is unproved.

errors.description: Lemma 4 is the entire lower bound, and its only substantive step is skipped. One must argue that the pair-multigraph on the n+1 original pieces has at most n edges, hence an acyclic (loop-free) component; then 2-colour that tree, check every part of a component vertex is paired inside the component, and handle the unpaired part. None of this is given.
errors.quote: By a tree-component argument on the multigraph whose vertices are the original pieces $0,1,\dots,n$ and whose edges are the pairs $P_i$, there is a set $V_T\subseteq\{0,\dots,n\}$ and signs $s:V_T\to\{\pm1\}$ such that the signed sum $\Xi:=\sum_{j\in V_T}s(j)\,q_j$ satisfies $|\Xi|\le\sum_i\varepsilon_i+[M\text{ odd}]\,a_M$ (standard; details omitted).

errors.description: Numerical/Monte-Carlo verification is offered as support for the omitted lemma; such checks carry no proof weight and cannot substitute for the missing argument.
errors.quote: plus 40000-trial Monte Carlo for Lemma 4 and 4000 exact-arithmetic random tests of the Lemma 5 construction

parsed.notes: Answer correct. Reduction to D(A) (Lemma 2) and the upper bound (Lemma 5, subset-sum gap + cross-pairing cuts, with correct mark count m-1=n) are complete and correct; the separation property (3.1) is proved. Only the lower-bound core is missing.
